title: Requests
purpose: Find specimen requests from investigators and follow each one from draft through decision, allocation and shipment.
summary: Specimen requests from investigators, followed from draft through decision, allocation and shipment.

tasks.title: Record a request you received
steps: Select [[New request]] and enter it as it was received.
Add the lines of material asked for, then submit it for a decision.

tasks.title: Find requests to decide
steps: Open [[More filters]], tick [[Awaiting my decision]] and select [[Apply]].

tasks.title: Find a request
steps: Type the RQ number or part of the title in [[Search]], or choose [[Status]] or [[Investigator]].

good_to_know: Investigators do not sign in. Staff record requests as they arrive.
You never decide a request you created or submitted.
[[Specimen]] under More filters finds every request that ever allocated that specimen.

sections.title: What the page shows
paragraphs: Each row is one specimen request, numbered RQ-000001 and up, newest first. Staff record requests as they arrive by email, letter, form or meeting; investigators do not sign in. A request moves from Draft to Awaiting decision, then Approved, Rejected or Returned for changes; an approved request is later Closed, and an unfinished one can be Cancelled. Requests are never deleted.
Every role that can sign in to the workspace can read this list, including viewers.

Type in the search box to narrow the rows, use the filters beside it and under More filters, and choose 25, 50 or 100 rows per page (25 by default). Active filters appear as chips you can remove one by one; Clear all removes them all. The sort and filters are kept in the address, so a view can be shared. A filter value that is not valid shows no rows rather than all of them. Changing a filter returns you to the first page.

sections.title: Search, filters and sorting
paragraphs: Search matches the request number (RQ-000012, RQ12 or 12) or part of the title. The default sort is Request, newest first. Sortable columns are Request, Status, Title, Investigator, Needed by and Created.

items.label: Status
items.description: Any status (the default), Open (not final: draft, awaiting decision, returned or approved), or one status.

items.label: Investigator
items.description: One investigator from the distribution catalogues.

items.label: Institution
items.description: One institution: the request takes its investigator's institution when it is created.

items.label: Specimen
items.description: Under More filters. A specimen ID such as VP-000123 (case and outer spaces are ignored); lists the requests that ever allocated that specimen, whatever the allocation's state. The specimen record links here with this filter set.

items.label: Specimens to pick
items.description: Under More filters. Requests with allocated specimens that are not yet picked. The dashboard queue "Approved requests with allocations to pick" links here with this filter and Status set to Approved.

items.label: Awaiting my decision
items.description: Under More filters, only for people with the request decision permission. Requests awaiting a decision that you neither created nor submitted, so you may decide them. The dashboard queue "Requests awaiting my decision" links here with this filter.

items.label: Request
items.description: The number; opens the request. Always shown.

items.label: Status
items.description: Draft, Awaiting decision, Returned for changes, Approved, Rejected, Cancelled or Closed.

items.label: Title
items.description: The request's title as recorded.

items.label: Investigator
items.description: The requesting investigator's name and code.

items.label: Institution
items.description: The institution the request is from.

items.label: Lines
items.description: How many lines (kinds of material) the request has.

items.label: Allocated or picked (specimens)
items.description: Specimens currently allocated to the request or picked from storage for it.

items.label: Shipped (specimens)
items.description: Specimens of the request that have been dispatched.

items.label: Needed by
items.description: The date the requester gave, if any.

items.label: Created
items.description: When the request was recorded.

items.label: New request
items.description: Technicians, managers and administrators. Opens the form to record a request as it was received.

items.label: Export CSV
items.description: Any staff role can download all matching rows across pages as UTF-8 CSV in the selected order. The file uses the current search and filters. Creation times use the repository's time zone. If more than 10,000 rows match when the export runs, the download stops. Narrow the filters and try again. Text that starts like a spreadsheet formula gets a leading apostrophe. The audit trail records who downloaded the selection, the filters and the number of data rows in the file. With no matches, the CSV contains only the header and the audit count is zero.

items.label: No specimen requests recorded
items.description: None has been recorded yet. Technicians and above see a New request button.

items.label: Nothing matches these filters
items.description: The search and filters exclude every request; change or clear them.

items.label: These filters cannot be applied
items.description: A filter value is not valid; correct it. No rows are shown until every filter is valid.
